npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-01.htm.text: Black Judge: Throughout their lives people commit varying degrees of sin. You, however, have never committed a sin so grievous that you required our assistance... You are on the right path! Your integrity is impressive! (This quest can only be undertaken by a character with a PK count of 1 or more.)

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-02.htm.text: Black Judge: Sinning is easy. Atoning for those sins, however, is much more difficult. Are you really prepared for this? We will test your resolve to its utmost on your journey of penitence... Are you ready to follow the path away from riches and fame?

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-07.html.text: Black Judge: You have not even taken one step forward on the path of penance. As I said before, this is not the way to fame or fortune. Nobody, including us black judges, can force you to follow this path. If you are having doubts, leave now and never come back.

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-08.html.text: Black Judge: Don't say a word. I can tell that you have completed your task. Take this to Blacksmith Pushkin in Giran Castle Town . He will make an item for you. When he finishes it, bring it back to us.
when: state STARTED; lacks items 4331,4426,4330,4425; !memoState < 9; memoState >= 9; memoState <= 12

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-09.html.text: Black Judge: There is no hurry. The path of penance will endlessly unfold in front of you. Go to Blacksmith Pushkin of the Town of Giran . He will make an item for you. Bring this item to us.
when: state STARTED; has items 4331,4426,4330,4425; lacks items 4426,4330,4425; !memoState < 9; memoState >= 9; memoState <= 12

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-10.html.text: Black Judge: Have you brought back the Manacles of Penitence ? You must bring them to me. You shall wear them until you have finished your penitence.
when: state STARTED; has items 4331,4426,4330,4425; lacks items 4331,4426,4425; !memoState < 9; memoState >= 9; memoState <= 12; !(hasQuestItems(player, MANUAL_OF_MANACLES) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, MANACLES_OF_PENITENT, PENITENTS_MANACLES1

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-12.html.text: Black Judge: Your brother's hunger for your sins is not yet sated. Your penance must continue... All the terrible feelings that you are experiencing... the feelings of embarrassment, confusion, loneliness, and boredom etc... they are the manifestation of your sins that are now getting dissolved and…

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-13.html.text: Black Judge: Ha! Yes, your brother has grown fat on your sins, hasn't he? Let me see your hands.

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-16t.html.text: Black Judge: All of your transgressions have not yet been redeemed. You must begin your penitence once again. Would you be in need of a sin eater ?

links.text: "I wish to atone for my sins."

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-03.htm.text: Black Judge: Very well, the test can begin. You must go and see Katari , a Dark Elf. She teaches the word of Einhasad to godless heathens, such as the Ol Mahums... She needs your help. Meet her at the edge of the Dark Elven Forest north of the Marshland and offer her your help. Come back to see us …

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-04.htm.text: Black Judge: Very well, the testing can begin. You will go help a farmer who lost all his possessions during the war between Gracia and Aden. He was left with less than a handful of seed! But this tenacious farmer is bravely trying to cultivate his crops. His name is Piotur. You will find him near …

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-05.htm.text: Black Judge: This is the first time that Elder Casian has ever met with a black judge. He has volunteered to walk the path of endless hardship. Right now he is working on a task in the southern Wasteland in Gludio . He is in trouble and needs some help... Go there and find him. Come back and see us…

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-06.htm.text: Black Judge: Magister Joan of the Ivory Tower , the daughter of a forest fairy, does not realize the importance of the work she is doing. You must go and help her. You must not ask or answer any questions while dealing with her. Come back and see us after completing the task. (This quest is automat…

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-11.html.text: Black Judge: At the other end of this chain is the Sin Eater . He is your brother, and will come if you call his name. Now you must leave. When you have completed your penance once, come back and see us. That will be the time when you two will part your ways. At that time, you will be released from…

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-14.html.text: Black Judge: We now release you. Sin Eater will return to the bottomless Abyss that spawned him. In there your sin will be absolved into the great void.

links.text: Ask what you have left for your sin

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-15.html.text: Black Judge: Your sins have been washed away. At least the ones we know about... The Sin Eater can help you no further. You must make your own choices from now on, and become your own Sin Eater.

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-15t.html.text: Black Judge: These chains cannot be broken as long as your brother remains in this world. You must now release him to return from whence he came. Release the sin eater !

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-16.html.text: Black Judge: Ah, yes, there are more sins, aren't there... Are you willing to continue to carry out your task to atone for your sins?

links.text: "I wish to atone for my remaining sins."

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-17.html.text: Black Judge: Very well. Give me your hands.

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30981-18.html.text: Black Judge: Have you grown weary of the path of penance? Do as you will. No one is forcing you to do this. You are the one who made all the wrong choices... If you have decided to live with them, we respect that. Walk your own path.

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-01.html.text: Black Judge: Death leaves a scar which all must bear. Do you wish it to be healed completely? Ah, I perceive that you have long been apart from this world. I am strangely heartened by your return. I will heal this wound and remove death's scar.

links.text: Remove 1 level of Death Penalty (3600 Adena).

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-02.html.text: Black Judge: Death leaves a scar which all must bear. Do you wish it to be healed completely? You have only recently begun your journey in this world, and your youth touches me. I will heal this wound and remove death's scar.

links.text: Remove 1 level of Death Penalty (8640 Adena)

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-03.html.text: Black Judge: Death leaves a scar which all must bear. Do you wish it to be healed completely? You have only begun to learn the world, and your innocence touches me. I will heal this wound and remove death's scar.

links.text: Remove 1 level of Death Penalty (25200 Adena).

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-04.html.text: Black Judge: Death leaves a scar which all must bear. Do you wish it to be healed completely? As I see you are a true adventurer, I will heal this wound and remove death's scar.

links.text: Remove 1 level of Death Penalty (50400 Adena).

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-05.html.text: Black Judge: Death leaves a scar which all must bear. Do you wish it to be healed completely? Great adventurer, I will heal this wound and remove death's scar.

links.text: Remove 1 level of Death Penalty (86400 Adena)

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-06.html.text: Black Judge: Death leaves a scar which all must bear. Do you wish it to be healed completely? Because you walk the hero's path, I will heal this wound and remove death's scar.

links.text: Remove 1 level of Death Penalty (144000 Adena).

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-07.html.text: Black Judge: The wound you have received from death's touch is too deep to be healed for the money you have to give me. Find more money if you wish death's mark to be fully removed from you.

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981-08.html.text: Black Judge: You have no more death wounds that require healing. Go forth and fight, both for this world and your own glory.

ai/npc/BlackJudge/30981.html.text: Black Judge: I came to this land to save those poor souls who are contaminated by sin. We black judges do not divide good and evil by light and darkness. We help instead those with strong wills and noble souls -- whether or not they wish our help. Come, sinners, come to us . . .
